formula: 0.5 * P(MERGE without AlphaGenome) + 0.5 * ECDF percentile of the selected AlphaGenome column
component_transform: training-fold median imputation, then mid-rank empirical CDF against the training-fold AlphaGenome values; no labels, no fitted model
missing_policy: evaluation: a missing AlphaGenome score takes the training-fold median before the percentile transform, so every variant is scored; deployment: the average is computed only where AlphaGenome has a score (alphagenome_observed = 1)
